desc:
Become a little villager, grab a job from the village Labor Board, and pull weeds across the fields to earn yen in this cozy tycoon!

🌿 Pull — Tap when the pink pin hits the green zone. Land on ★ for a PERFECT!
💰 Sell — Bag full? Trade your weeds for yen at the Grass stall
📜 Weeding Exam — Rank up from Grade 5 to Grade 1 and unlock new fields
📖 Weed Journal — Collect every species. Golden weeds are out there!
🌧 Weather — Pull in rain, meteor showers, rainbows or at night for special mutations
🍜 Village — Fill up on ramen, takoyaki and a hot bath for buffs
🏠 Your House — Collect furniture, decorate and invite friends
🚲 Tandem Bike — Give a friend a ride on the back seat

When everyone's weeds reach the goal, a GIANT food appears in the plaza. Eat together for a festival buff!

🎁 Coupon: Settings → Coupon → CHIIKAWA, PAJAMA, THANKS100
